title: When Should a Voice Agent Speak? End-of-Turn Detection in Turkish
abstract: arXiv:2611.25489v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A voice agent that waits for a fixed silence before replying either interrupts users who pause mid-utterance or responds late to users who have finished. This study examines the decision at the onset of silence, using turn ends and turn-internal pauses extracted from the Real-TurnTurk corpus of Turkish dyadic video calls. A fine-tuned Turkish TurnGPT model, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a deployed multilingual detector are compared, together with voice-activity timing and facial features, under recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation with paired cluster bootstrap tests. On held-out recordings, the fine-tuned model separates turn ends from pauses better than both text baselines and is the best calibrated of the three. Timing features of the current speaker are similarly informative, and their combination with the fine-tuned text score gives the best timing-based results; with logistic regression, this combination also

translated_title: 语音助手应何时发言？土耳其语的轮次结束检测
translated_abstract: 一个在回复前等待固定静音时长的语音助手，要么会打断在话语中途停顿的用户，要么对已完成发言的用户响应过晚。本研究考察了静音开始时的决策问题，使用了从土耳其语双人视频通话的 Real-TurnTurk 语料库中提取的轮次结束和轮次内停顿数据。研究比较了经过微调的土耳其语 TurnGPT 模型、零样本土耳其语语言模型和已部署的多语言检测器，并结合语音活动时间特征和面部特征，在记录分离和说话者分离的评估设置下采用配对聚类自助法检验进行评估。在留出的录音上，微调后的模型在区分轮次结束与停顿方面优于两个文本基线，且在三者中校准效果最佳。当前说话者的时间特征同样具有信息量，其与微调文本分数相结合可获得基于时间特征的最佳结果；通过逻辑回归，这一组合还……
tldr: 本研究基于土耳其语双人视频通话语料库，比较微调 TurnGPT、零样本语言模型和多语言检测器在区分话轮结束与轮次内停顿上的表现，发现微调模型效果最佳且校准最好，与说话者时间特征结合可获得最佳的话轮结束检测性能。
en_tdlr: This study compares a fine-tuned Turkish TurnGPT, a zero-shot language model, and a deployed multilingual detector for end-of-turn detection in Turkish video calls, showing that the fine-tuned model best separates turn ends from pauses and that combining it with speaker timing features yields the best timing-based results.
